name: zennodroid-mcp
description: Official MCP servers for ZennoDroid: read and edit projects, run and monitor tasks, control Android devices. Requires ZennoDroid 2.6.1+ on Windows. The servers are local executables: download them from the repository releases and start each one with an API key before connecting. ZennoDroid's product API and MCP ports are the ZennoPoster ones shifted by +10, so start MCP.ProjectMaker with --urls http://localhost:6217 --ProjectMaker:BaseUrl=http://localhost:5309/api/v1 and MCP.ZennoPoster with --urls http://localhost:6220 --ZennoPoster:BaseUrl=http://localhost:5310/api/v1. MCP.Android runs twice, like MCP.Instance does on ZennoPoster: the shipped default (6211) drives the device attached to ProjectMaker, and a second copy on 6212 with --Android:Target=zennoposter --Android:BaseUrl=http://localhost:5310/api/v1 drives the devices of running tasks.
